decisions.checker_reason: RP02 (Outbound payment reject report) produces payment‑reject evidence and depends on reject/repair review controls (C067‑C074). C093 is a synthetic daily completeness control that depends on I04 (Settlement status feed) and is part of the Operational report completeness review family. There is no visible edge or shared process linking RP02 to I04 or to C093, so the changed report does not reach the function governed by C093.
